title: Hall without a name on the plan
subtitle: Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: a block drawn on the plan in the Xiyang Lou strip; heights a guess
platform 0.8 m, eave 7 m, ridge 9.5 m above the ground
reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water

searched: This block has no name on the plan or in the texts, so no source can be searched for it by name.

photos.why: Printed title. Central door under double stair: the plan shows the east end block split by an E-W passage , so that passage should be this door. Upper hall: reservoir range, form only.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 2x4 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
